creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-26 (lane B, mist_archive), 2026-11-22; operator tien-nghich-2d-26
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, custom template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 7) then animate_character v3 per direction (keep_first_frame=false, palette passed; canvases come back 36-44 px and are centred on 32 by the build script). All four facings are separate PixelLab generations; nothing is mirrored. Diagonal direction_prompts keys are required by the tool and were filled with 'unused diagonal: ...' placeholders; no diagonal was generated.
prompt: Small ink leech, a fat slug-like segmented worm creeping low on the ground, glossy ink-black body with pale cream-white ring bands across its back, a round toothed sucker mouth at the front with a few small cream fangs, a bright vermilion dot on its head, a dripping ink-blot puddle at its tail end. 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: rests low on the ground, the segmented body pulses slowly with a gentle swell and shrink, the sucker mouth opens slightly, the red dot on the head stays visible

direction_prompts.south: head toward the viewer, body pulses slowly, mouth opens slightly
direction_prompts.west: head toward the left, body pulses slowly, mouth opens slightly, tail on the right
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, body pulses slowly
direction_prompts.east: head toward the right, body pulses slowly, mouth opens slightly, tail on the left

walk.action_description: inches forward in a looping crawl, the body bunches up then stretches out segment by segment, head leads, red dot stays visible, no effects

direction_prompts.south: crawls toward the viewer, body bunches then stretches, stays compact
direction_prompts.west: crawls to the left, body bunches then stretches, tail trails on the right
direction_prompts.north: crawls away from the viewer, seen from behind, body bunches then stretches
direction_prompts.east: crawls to the right, body bunches then stretches, tail trails on the left

telegraph.action_description: rears its front third up off the ground and swells, the sucker mouth opens wide showing small fangs, the body coils back ready to lunge, no effects

direction_prompts.south: head toward the viewer, rears up and swells, mouth opens wide, coils back
direction_prompts.west: head toward the left, rears up and swells, mouth opens wide, coils back, tail on the right
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, rears up and swells, coils back
direction_prompts.east: head toward the right, rears up and swells, mouth opens wide, coils back, tail on the left

strike.action_description: lunges forward with its whole body stretched long and bites with the open sucker mouth, then recoils and contracts back, no effects

direction_prompts.south: head toward the viewer, lunges toward the viewer and bites, then recoils, stays compact
direction_prompts.west: head toward the left, lunges to the left and bites, then recoils, tail on the right
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, lunges forward away from the viewer, then recoils
direction_prompts.east: head toward the right, lunges to the right and bites, then recoils, tail on the left

frame_count_note: The mob profile wants 3 frames for idle and telegraph but PixelLab v3 only returns even counts (min 4). Idle: 4 generated, last dropped. Telegraph: 4 generated, frame 1 dropped (kept 0, 2, 3, renumbered 0-2). The raw folder holds the kept frames only.

attempts.what: create_character_pro_flash 32x32, custom template (no limbs, no skeleton), seed 7, palette locked
attempts.result: accepted: banded ink leech with red dot and sucker mouth reads on all four facings

attempts.what: idle, walk, telegraph, strike x 4 directions, first take
attempts.result: all accepted; no clip-direction needed a regeneration

known_flaws: a very dark ink body on the dark outline gives low internal contrast at 1x; the cream ring bands and the teal head carry the read
the south and north views are near-symmetric blobs; the red dot is visible only from the front and sides
the custom template has no skeleton, so walk is a v3 bunch-and-stretch, not a template gait
the spec's ink-blot puddle at the tail was not preserved as a separate shape; the tail curls into a dark hook instead
